title: Bytesized Font
description: A clean, compact pixel font that brings retro gaming aesthetics to Minecraft's text.
body:
# Bytesized Font for Minecraft

Transform your Minecraft experience with **Bytesized** - a crisp, compact pixel font that brings a fresh retro aesthetic to your game!

![Bytesized Font Showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/YtzkKx0U/images/1c76832415285466b1df1a5b211fac47b58c1785.png)

## ✨ Features

**Bytesized** offers a clean, readable pixel art style perfect for players who want:
- Sharp, well-defined characters that are easy to read
- A compact design that fits more text on screen
- Authentic retro gaming vibes
- Excellent readability in menus, chat, and signs

## 📦 What's Included

This resource pack replaces Minecraft's default font with Bytesized across the entire game - menus, chat, signs, books, and all UI elements.

## 🎮 Installation

1. Download the resource pack
2. Place the `.zip` file in your `resourcepacks` folder
3. Open Minecraft and go to **Options → Resource Packs**
4. Move **Bytesized Font** to the active side
5. Enjoy your new font!

## 💡 Perfect For

- Players who love pixel art aesthetics
- Anyone wanting a cleaner, more compact font
- Retro gaming enthusiasts
- Builders who want stylish signs and books

## 📋 Credits

This pack uses **Bytesized** font by The Bytesized Project Authors, licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.

## 🔧 Compatibility

- **Supports:** Minecraft 1.13+
- **Works with:** All Minecraft versions that support custom fonts
- **Compatible with:** Other resource packs (as long as they don't modify fonts)

---

Upgrade your Minecraft text today with Bytesized! ✨
